hooks.command: sh -c 'f="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"; case "$f" in *.prisma) command -v prisma >/dev/null 2>&1 && npx prisma format --schema="$f" || true;; *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx) command -v prettier >/dev/null 2>&1 && npx prettier --write "$f" || true;; esac'

sh -c 'echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_COMMAND" | grep -Eq "prisma (migrate reset|db push --force-reset)|docker (compose )?down -v|rm -rf .*(node_modules|\.git)" && { echo "[formento-guard] Destructive command blocked — confirm with the user before running this manually." >&2; exit 1; } || exit 0'
